methods.label: Add tens and ones
methods.explanation: Add tens to tens and ones to ones: \(30+20=50\) and \(2+5=7\). This gives 5 tens and 7 ones. \(32+25=57\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 1 whole-tens addition, addition within 10, and tens-and-ones place value.
